FRONT-END UI SOFTWARE ENGINEER, 
 2+ to 5 years experience
 

 And we make games - How cool is that? In fact, we entertain millions of people across the globe with the most amazing and immersive interactive software in the industry. But making games is hard work. That's why we employ the most creative and passionate people in the industry.  

 

 Save the planet from Alien Invaders. Score the winning touchdown. 

 

 Yup - It's the coolest job on the planet!
 

 Required: 

 

 •Intermediate to Advanced level Javascript (AJAX, Promises, JS Modules). 

 

 

 •Intermediate to Advanced level CSS (Object Oriented CSS, CSS3).
 

 

 •Experience in Angular JS
 

 

 •Understanding web performance parameters and factors
 

 

 •Proficient in front-end web technologies.
 

 

 •Proficient in using REST API-s
 

 

 •Experience with Source Control systems.
 

 

 •4+ years of software development experience.
 

 

 •Experience working closely with creative design teams.
 

 

 •Experience working in Agile/Scrum-based development environments.
 

 

 

 

 

 Good to have:
 

 

 

 

 •Experience with SEO and Google Analytics .
 

 

 •Experience working with backed systems like CMS
 

 

 •Able to communicate with technical and non-technical team members.
 

 

 •Computing Science background.
 

 

 

 

 

 Soft Skills (Required):
 

 

 

 

 •Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 

 

 •Ability to work in a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
 

 

 •Ability to quickly learn and apply new concepts, principles and solutions.
 

 

 •Demonstrates dependability and commitment to projects/tasks.
 

 

 •Self-starter, with strong aptitude towards rigorous testing and validation of work.
 

 

 •Ability to take the initiative to extract and document requirements.
 

 What's In It For YOU? Glad You Asked! 

 

 Unleash Your Inner Genius - Apply Today 

 

 

 

 

 SKILLS AND CERTIFICATIONS
 Javascript
 CSS
 Angular JS
 Object-Oriented


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
